utils.setchannel_ok:
✅ This channel will receive **episode release cards** for **this server**.
• Tracked anime list: **`/airings`** (e.g. **`/airings all`** for admins).
• **Independent** from the **raid boss** channel (`/raidconfig`).
• If you get **no** alerts while the list is filled: check **bot permissions** here, and that the AniList API responds (alerts use the post-air window).
utils.setlevelup_ok:
✅ This channel will receive the following **announcements** (instead of the channel where play happens):
• **New global title** (XP `/profile`, `/myrank`) — one announcement per **title tier**, not every level.
• **New quiz title** (solo quiz score `/animequiz`, `/animequizmulti`) — same tiers as on the card.
• To reset default behaviour: **`/clearlevelupchannel`**.
utils.clearlevelup_ok: ✅ Level-up announcements will again be posted **in the channel where the game happened** (or not announced if XP was granted without a channel).
utils.config_err: ❌ An error occurred while saving settings.

botinfo.field_slash_val: Slash commands can take **1–2 min** to show after inviting the bot.

botinfo.field_bug_val: **`/reportbug`** — report a bug in **DMs**; if you help fix a real issue, you can earn **XP** (see **`/mycard`** if you already have validated reports).
botinfo.field_al_val_unlinked: Not linked — **`/linkanilist`** then **`/verifyanilist`** for stats, DM recaps, quick `/mystats`…

desc.next: Next episode — **server** mode = your server list (`/airings`); **global** mode = all releases.
desc.planning: Weekly schedule — **server** mode = server list; **global** = all releases.
desc.decouverte: Random anime (AniList) — **slash** replies are **ephemeral**; Again / Track buttons.
desc.monnext: Your next episode (linked AniList account required).
desc.animequiz: Solo quiz: guess the anime from the image (difficulty choice) — XP and quiz score.
desc.animequizmulti: Chain **5–20** solo quizzes in a row (mixed difficulties) — XP and combos.
desc.guessop: Guess the opening (audio) — blind test on real themes.
desc.guessopchain: Chain several Guess OP rounds with streak bonus and score recap.
desc.guessyear: Guess the air year (image + answer in channel).
desc.guessepisodes: Guess the episode count (image + answer in channel).
desc.guessgenre: Guess one of the genres (image + text answer).
desc.guesswho: Guess the character on a blurred image — Easy / Normal / Hard (blur + XP).
desc.chainquiz: Chain solo quizzes: difficulty rises with each correct answer.
desc.raid_statut: Channel, schedule, auto or not, next slot (bot timezone).
desc.raidconfig: Admins: interactive panel (channel, auto ON/OFF, day, hour, minutes, precise HH:MM).
desc.raidstart: Start a raid boss (admin): confirmation + max 1× per week / server.
desc.raidalerttest: Send a test “raid in 1 h” style message (admin).
desc.minijeux: Two menus: **Guessing games** and **Other** — pick to start a game (duel → `/duel @member`).
desc.linkanilist: Step 1: link AniList with a code in your bio, then `/verifyanilist`.
desc.verifyanilist: Step 2: confirm the link after pasting the code in About on AniList.
desc.streak: Show your daily streak and record.
desc.mission: Today’s mission: claim XP or reroll (1/week).
desc.showmission: Mission catalogue by **category** (dropdown) + your stats (ephemeral in slash). Alias: `missionsliste`.
desc.mycard: Panoramic image (level, XP, AniList, favourite, minigames) — no embed; details: **`/profile`**.
desc.profile: Detailed profile: XP, streak, minigame counters, Guess genre penalties, trophy preview.
desc.animefav: Set your favourite anime (title, ID or AniList URL) — shown on **`/mycard`**.
desc.reportbug: Report a bug in **DMs**; **XP** if confirmed — counter on **`/mycard`**.
desc.mystats: AniList stats (watched, days, mean score, favourite genre).
desc.mybadges: Trophies by category (Initiate → Myth tiers) and progress bars.
desc.duelstats: AniList engagement duel: completed, airing, episodes, time (+ rating if both rate).
desc.quiztop: Quiz leaderboard + last month’s podium and rewards.
desc.animetop: Minigame leaderboard with dropdown (total, preview or one game) — podium + table; names via Discord if off-server.
desc.quizlevels: Quiz tiers (monthly score) and XP ranks: **one menu** to choose what to show.
desc.stats: AniList stats for a specified user.
desc.add: Add an anime to your watchlist.
desc.remove: Remove an anime from your watchlist.
desc.setchannel: Channel for episode release cards (/airings list). Independent from raid channel (`/raidconfig`).
desc.setlevelupchannel: Channel for announcements: new global title (XP) and new quiz title (else: channel where play happened).
desc.guide_admin: (DM, admins) Server setup: airings, setchannel, XP levels, raid.
desc.vote: ⭐ Support the bot on Top.gg: link, bonus XP, cooldown; DM reminder (buttons).
desc.recap: DM recap “Releases today” (linked AniList). Buttons + HH:MM input; precision with `/setalert`.
desc.setalert: HH:MM time for DM recap (bot timezone). Complements `/recap` for a precise time (e.g. 08:30).
desc.source: Link to the bot’s GitHub repo.
desc.uptime: How long the bot has been running.
desc.airings: Server list: pick anime tracked for /next and /planning (admin).
desc.all: Browse AniList releases and fill the server list (admin).
desc.guide: (DM) Player tutorial: XP, minigames, AniList — not server setup (see `/guide_admin`).
desc.owner: Owner panel: debug, sync, stats, tests, Guess OP, raid test — dropdown.
